Amit Shah to visit Kolkata for Shyama Prasad Mukherjee's birth anniversary

Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to visit Kolkata to attend events commemorating the 125th birth anniversary of Shyama Prasad Mukherjee, founder of the Bharatiya Jan Sangh. Shah will visit Mukherjee's ancestral home and is expected to lay the foundation stone for a proposed 125-foot statue. The visit is seen as part of the BJP's preparations and political strategy in West Bengal.
